description: Daily protein target in grams from body weight and activity level: the IOM RDA for the life stage (0.8 g/kg for adults; 0.85 at 14 to 18, 1.1 in the second half of pregnancy, 1.3 while breastfeeding) and an activity-scaled range up to the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics / Dietitians of Canada / ACSM (2016) 1.2 to 2.0 g/kg athlete range. Needs age, sex, height, weight and activity; pass pregnancy or lactation when either applies. Under 18 the answer is the RDA alone: range is null, byActivity is empty and activity_range_withheld is "under_18", because the activity ranges are adult sports-nutrition guidance.

activity.description: Physical activity level. Defaults to sedentary.

height_cm.description: Height in centimeters (or use height_ft + height_in).

lactation.description: Breastfeeding status. The protein RDA follows it.

pregnancy.description: Pregnancy status. The protein RDA follows it.

sex.description: Biological sex — drives the energy equation.
